normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Amphibia species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals one or more official ITIS invalid species names whose synonym_links rows resolve to exactly one valid ITIS Amphibia species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Amphibia species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Amphibia species.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.webLight: Optional lazy package sidecar; do not add it to default precache.
deliveryContract.zip: Include the exact sidecar bytes with the Amphibia package ZIP when a runtime integration is approved.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Include the same checksum-addressed sidecar bytes in Android and iOS complete-data inventories when a runtime integration is approved.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, fixed roots, exact SQL, exact representation-only normalization and stable sorting; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
